source_definitions: P255 research-arc: W_i=E_TD_i(R)-E_TD_i(start), X_i=E_TD_i-E_BO_i; Axiom2136 work-minus-encounter-excitation convention
consequence: After a common absolute reference/mapping, work minus all encounter excitation is identically the matched BO interaction. A 20-percent dynamic-vs-static difference of this quantity measures closure/reference error, not a physical speed dependence.
unresolved_decision: The velocity-dependent path-work/encounter-excitation observable must remain distinct from the static BO potential; choose which nonadiabatic observable controls extending the incident-energy sweep.
scope: Exact identity under the stated definitions, not an assertion that real collision dynamics are adiabatic
